'''Mike Fitzgerald''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/decks99k.htm No Shelter], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228072350/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/decks99k.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
